name: Privacy
description: Windows MDM settings in the Privacy category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Auto Accept Pairing And Privacy Consent Prompts
properties.description: Allows or disallows the automatic acceptance of the pairing and privacy user consent dialog when launching apps. NoteThere were issues reported with the previous release of this policy and a fix was Most restricted value is 0.

properties.name: Allow Cross Device Clipboard
properties.description: Allows syncing of Clipboard across devices under the same Microsoft account.

properties.name: Allow Input Personalization
properties.description: Updated in Windows 10, version 1809. This policy specifies whether users on the device have the option to enable online speech recognition. When enabled, users can use their voice for dictation and to talk to Cortana and other apps that use Microsoft cloud-based speech recognition. Microsoft will use voice input to help improve our speech services. If the policy value is set to 0, online speech recognition will be disabled and users cannot enable online speech recognition via settings. If policy value is set to 1 or is not configured, control is deferred to users. Most restricted value is 0.

properties.name: Disable Advertising ID
properties.description: Enables or disables the Advertising ID. Most restricted value is 0.

properties.name: Disable Privacy Experience
properties.description: Enabling this policy prevents the privacy experience from launching during user logon for new and upgraded users.

properties.name: Disable Privacy Experience (User)
properties.description: Enabling this policy prevents the privacy experience from launching during user logon for new and upgraded users.

properties.name: Enable Activity Feed
properties.description: Enables ActivityFeed, which is responsible for mirroring different activity types (as applicable) across device graph of the user.

Force deny. Windows apps cannot be activated by voice and users cannot change it.

properties.name: Turn off InPrivate Browsing
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to turn off the InPrivate Browsing feature.

InPrivate Browsing prevents Internet Explorer from storing data about a user's browsing session. This includes cookies, temporary Internet files, history, and other data.

If you enable this policy setting, InPrivate Browsing is turned off.

If you disable this policy setting, InPrivate Browsing is available for use.

If you do not configure this policy setting, InPrivate Browsing can be turned on or off through the registry.

properties.name: Turn off InPrivate Browsing (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to turn off the InPrivate Browsing feature.

InPrivate Browsing prevents Internet Explorer from storing data about a user's browsing session. This includes cookies, temporary Internet files, history, and other data.

If you enable this policy setting, InPrivate Browsing is turned off.

If you disable this policy setting, InPrivate Browsing is available for use.

If you do not configure this policy setting, InPrivate Browsing can be turned on or off through the registry.

properties.name: Upload User Activities
properties.description: Allows ActivityFeed to upload published 'User Activities'.
